description: National Rail Network 1:2,000,000 Nodes is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors (comp.) Bureau of Transportation Statistics. The Rail Network is a database of the nation's railway system including all railway mainlines, railroad yards, and major sidings in the continental U.S. at the 1:2,000,000 scale. The data set covers the 48 contiguous States plus the District of Columbia. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For non-commercial use only. Acknowledgment of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics National Transportation Atlas would be appreciated in products. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
